title.narrative: Climate Smart - Technical support for SADC Regional Vulnerability Assessment & Analysis (RVAA)

description.narrative: This activity Climate Smart - Technical support for SADC Regional Vulnerability Assessment & Analysis (RVAA) is a component of Climate Smart Agriculture in Africa reported by FCDO with a funding type of 104 - Procurement of Services and a budget of £5,580,732. This project benefits Africa, regional. It works in the following sector(s): Environmental policy and administrative management, Agricultural development.
